abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Initial inspection of input_targets found three single-chain coordinate-only PDBs with no HEADER/SEQRES/DBREF/HET records or bound ligands. ATOM-derived sequences were extracted to experiments/target_id/*.fasta. Target1 is a 151 aa soluble helical segment (chain J, residues 171-321); target2 is a 257 aa soluble domain fragment (chain A, residues 580-867 with gaps 610-635 and 786-790); target3 is a 292 aa multi-pass membrane protein (chain R, residues 1-300 with one 8 aa gap).

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Durable implication: target identification and ligand selection must rely on ATOM sequence/structure fingerprints and external sequence/structure searches, not PDB metadata or cocrystal ligands.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: RCSB sequence search and local CA alignment identified target1 as Mcl-1 (Q07820; 4HW2/4HW3/4HW4 ligand/BH3 family), target2 as TYK2 JH2 pseudokinase domain (P29597; 3ZON/4OLI/4WOV ligand complexes), and target3 as GPR119/glucose-dependent insulinotropic receptor (Q8TDV5; 7XZ5/7XZ6/8VHF GPCR complexes). Target3 is coordinate-identical to 7XZ5 chain R after stripping non-target components; target1 aligns to 4HW3 chain B at 0.388 A CA RMSD; target2 aligns to 4WOV chain B at 0.472 A CA RMSD.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: This supports target-specific scaffold selection: Mcl-1 carboxylate hydrophobic groove ligands; TYK2 JH2 allosteric/pseudokinase inhibitors; GPR119 agonist GPCR ligands.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: A target-specific panel was assembled from RCSB co-crystal ligands and named public analogs: Mcl-1 19G/19H/AZD5991, TYK2 3SM/2TT/IK1/deucravacitinib, and GPR119 8VP/I7J/OEA. Local tier-2 Vina/RDKit evaluation favored Mcl-1 19G (affinity -9.414; official-weighted proxy 87.6644), TYK2 2TT (affinity -8.092; official-weighted proxy 86.6038), and GPR119 8VP/MBX-2982 (affinity -9.912; official-weighted proxy 87.7859).

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Rejected alternatives were meaningful: Mcl-1 19H was close but lower official proxy; AZD5991/S63845-like large inhibitors carry property/SA risk; TYK2 3SM/deucravacitinib dock well but scored lower after route/SA balance; GPR119 I7J and OEA were inferior, with OEA rotor risk.

abstract.value: Selected one target-specific ligand per result file: result1 uses Mcl-1 co-crystal ligand 19G (benzothiophene-2-carboxylic acid hydrophobic-groove inhibitor); result2 uses TYK2 4OLI ligand 2TT (small allosteric/JH2-compatible amide scaffold with best route-weighted local score); result3 uses GPR119 8VHF ligand 8VP/MBX-2982 (GPCR agonist scaffold).

detail.label: Note
detail.value: This set optimizes the contest contract balance: direct public structural evidence, no local RDKit route/property failures, concise convergent one-step routes, and all three candidates above historical official-weighted proxy thresholds.
